recommendedTextbook.title: Countdown to WASSCE/SSCE English Language
recommendedTextbook.author: O. Ogunsanwo and C. E. Oyetunde

subtopics: Relative clauses with who, whom, whose, which, that

State grammatical name and function of underlined clauses
Punctuate restrictive and non-restrictive relative clauses

topics.topic: Concord: Rules of Proximity and Plural Quantifiers
subtopics: Subject-verb agreement with compound subjects and correlative conjunctions (either...or)

objectives: Apply proximity concord correctly in tricky sentence structures

topics.topic: Formal Letter Writing: Applications and Petitions
subtopics: Format: Two addresses, formal salutation, title, sign-off
Formal tone, impersonal passive voice, and concise paragraphs
Writing job applications and letters to the editor
objectives: Draft a standard formal letter adhering strictly to WASSCE format
Demonstrate appropriate register without colloquialisms or slang
Avoid common formatting errors in the date and valediction

topics.topic: Summary Writing: Extraction of Specific Points
subtopics: Rules of summary: Brevity, originality, precision
Avoiding mindless lifting and verbatim quotation
Converting paragraphs into single concise sentences
objectives: Identify required points answering specific summary questions
Paraphrase ideas using own words without changing original meaning
Score maximum marks by eliminating irrelevant examples and anecdotes
